task_card.title: Object Stamp Flow - extract an object from one image, place it into another

next_action.description: Build the stage-2 step kind (MpiStepPlace or similar): ShapeManager in 'place' mode + the Remove Background branch + an add/subtract alpha brush + UndoStack, mounting the History engines whole exactly as MpiStepPaint mounts PaintManager. Keep bgMask and userMask as TWO layers composited only at dispatch, and make the brush work with the toggle off. The bench is stopped and is not needed for this step.

key_decisions: The graph is flow_draw_it_in.json PATCHED, never rebuilt - that is where crop/stitch and the six LoRA slots come from, and Fabio confirmed this is the right base.

Law 7 (in brief.md): every reference must be framed like the OUTPUT frame. Auto passed the clean scene at FULL frame against a cropped output frame, and the model painted that wide scene into the narrow one - the patch stitched back as a miniature room inside the table. The fix is the second InpaintCropImproved (node 210) that crops the clean scene to the same region. Draw It In never met this because it has one reference and that reference IS the crop.

Law 8 (in brief.md): the stitch mask is the contract and NO PROMPT CAN REACH IT. InpaintStitchImproved writes back only the box while the model paints the whole crop, so a Manual gun came back sliced through the grip. Fabio proposed a prompt clause; it was tested as one clause on measured evidence and REJECTED - 2.2% of pixels moved and the cut stayed, because the model already keeps the object whole inside its own frame. Do not re-attempt; the row is in prompts.md's does-NOT-work table.

Canonical crop config: context_from_mask_extend_factor = 1.0, write-back grown with mask_expand_pixels at ~30% of the box side (83px on a 276px box). Canvas == write-back, so slicing is impossible and the cast shadow has room. This SUPERSEDES Draw It In's 4.267 constant, which sizes the crop and now has no job.
constraints: Two bench-only deviations are baked into the saved graphs and must NOT reach the shipped one: MpiClearVram (node 170) was dropped and the seed is pinned.
mask_expand_pixels is an INT input, so the 30% must be driven off MpiMaskSquareBbox.size through an MpiMath rather than hard-coded.

MPI-607 (also in `doing`) holds a STALE claim - heartbeat 2026-08-23, far past the 120-minute timeout - on every app-side file this card needs: flowsRegistry.js, commandRegistry.js, operationRegistry.js, operation_registry.json, universal_workflows.js and tests/inject-params-titles.test.cjs. Resolve it before the wiring step rather than writing through it blind.
Object colour fidelity still wanders run to run (the same gun came back black at one crop size and tan at another). Recorded, not blocking, worth a sweep once the app side runs.
ColorMatch is INERT on a modern plate (mean delta 0.032/255, 0.32% of pixels above 3). Keep it for the vintage case but do not credit it for anything.
The gun plate is the documented Auto-failure case (brief law 1) - use the mug or the Google logo to judge Auto, and the gun only for Manual.

The bench was stopped at the end of this session. Restart with G:/ComfyUi/run_nvidia_gpu.bat (port 8188) ONLY if more graph work is needed. Never point anything at 48188, that is Fabio's live app engine.
